Humanize.description: How far hits stray, like a drummer's hands: up to ±48 ticks (a sixty-fourth of a bar of 4/4) late or early at a `timing` of 1, and up to ±30% in velocity at a `velocity` of 1. Each pass of a pattern is a little different, and the same every time it plays.

timing.description: 0 is on the grid, 1 the most.

Meter.description: A time signature, as a groove states it.

denominator.description: The note value of a beat: 4 for quarter notes, 8 for eighths.

OrderStep.description: One step of a part's order: a section, played through so many times.

PartSection.description: A section of a part: a name, the kind of section it is when it is one of the usual ones, and its pattern.

fill.description: Another section's first bar played as a fill.

kind.description: Intro, verse, chorus, bridge, fill or ending; none for a section of your own.

name.description: Unique within the part; the order refers to the section by it.

pattern.description: What it plays, looped for as long as it lasts.

variations.description: Variations B, C and D of the pattern (which is A), at most three, each with its steps and resolution.

vary.description: How the variations take turns, pass by pass.

Pattern.description: A step sequencer pattern: a grid of pads against steps, with a velocity per cell. Patterns belong to the project and refer to pads by the ids the kit format uses (`kick`, `snare`, `hh-closed`…), so a pattern plays on any drum track whose kit has those pads.

humanize.description: How far the hits stray from the grid and from their velocity, for the whole pattern; a row can have its own.

length.description: Steps in the pattern, which loops after the last.

rows.description: One row per pad that has hits.

seed.description: Seeds the humanizing and the chance of each step, so the pattern plays the same way every time; change it for another take.

stepsPerBeat.description: Steps per quarter note: 2 for eighths, 4 for sixteenths, 8 for thirty-seconds; 3 and 6 for triplets.

swing.description: 0 is straight; 1 delays every second step by a third of a step, a triplet feel.

PatternRow.description: One pad's steps. `steps` holds exactly the pattern's length of velocities from 0 (no hit) to 1.

humanize.description: This row's own humanizing, instead of the pattern's.

marks.description: Steps that play by chance, ratchet or flam, in step order.

pad.description: The pad's id in the kit format.

steps.description: Velocity per step, 0 for no hit.

swing.description: This row's own swing, 0 to 1, instead of the pattern's.

Section.description: The part of a song a groove is for.

oneOf.description: Bigger: the crash or ride opens up.
A bar that leads into the next section.

SectionFill.description: When a section plays a fill: every few bars, at its end, or both, as a pattern clip's fill does.

atEnd.description: The section's last bar in the order is a fill.

every.description: The last bar of every this many is a fill; 0 for none.

section.description: The section whose first bar is the fill.

StepMark.description: What a step does beyond its velocity: whether it plays, how many times, and with a grace note before it.

chance.description: The chance it plays on a pass, 0 to 1.

flam.description: A soft grace note just before it.

ratchet.description: Hits in the step, evenly spaced: 1, or 2 to 4 for a ratchet.

Vary.description: How a section's variations take turns, one pass of the pattern each.

oneOf.description: A between each of the others: A B A C A D.
One after another: A B C D.

description: A whole drum part, as the drum designer saves it: sections (intro, verse, chorus, bridge, fill, ending or your own), each with a pattern, a fill and variations B to D; the order they play in; the kit; and the tempo and time signature it was made at. Section names are unique: the order and fills name sections by them.

genre.description: The genre it belongs to, if any: `Rock`, `Funk`…

kit.description: The kit it plays, by id.

name.description: Shown in the palette and the jam's groove picker.

order.description: The song: sections by name, each repeated a number of times.

sections.description: The sections, in the order the designer lists them.

tempo.description: The tempo it was made at, in beats per minute, 20 to 400.

timeSignature.description: The time signature it was made in.

title: Cantina groove
